head.backbone: Frozen DINOv2 ViT-L/14 crop descriptor; no backbone updates.
head.projection: LayerNorm(1024) -> Linear(1024,256) -> GELU -> Linear(256,128) -> L2 normalization.
head.training_signal: Two-tier identity metric hierarchy: same physical door across views must outrank a same-scene different door, which must outrank an ordinary different-class instance.
head.loss_family: Fixed-margin batch-hard triplet hierarchy with separately reported positive-hard and hard-ordinary gaps.
head.model_selection: Training-family validation only; no heldout-family score may select an epoch, margin, crop rule, or architecture.

literature_motivation.name: NearID
literature_motivation.use: Frozen backbone plus lightweight projection and an explicit same-identity versus near-identity versus random-negative hierarchy.

literature_motivation.name: IDOW
literature_motivation.use: Instance-level metric adaptation with batch-hard negative mining and distractor sampling.

literature_motivation.name: PiRO
literature_motivation.use: Multi-view physical identities motivate pose-varying positives rather than category-only crops.

next_action: Use only geometry and depth to select the first source-admitted hard and ordinary negative for each training identity; freeze exact RGB members and boxes only after that selection.
claim_boundary: This manifest is Development dataset construction only. It establishes neither physical-door retrieval improvement nor portal ownership, access, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety.
